items: A Phase III open-label trial carried out at 21 centers in the United States, 1200 patients who received up to five treatments with Azzalure® over a 13-month period
Patients had moderate to severe glabellar lines, were aged 18 years or older, and were excluded if they had received botulinum toxin treatment in the 85 days before study entry
Patients received up to five treatments with 50 U of Azzalure® with at least 85 days between treatments
The incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events decreased over time, with no evidence of cumulative safety issues
80–91% of patients responded to repeat treatment at Day 30 in each cycle
93–95% of patients reported onset of response by Day 7 in all cycles
The median onset of effect was 3 days after injection for all cycles
The median duration of effect was 88 days as assessed by investigators and 84 days as assessed by patients

chapters.heading: **1. Dysport® is supported by years of clinical experience**

content.text: **XEOMIN® has over 15 years of scientific and clinical evidence,**¹ as well as over **200 publications** and over **10 million vials** sold worldwide.²

Clinical trials and other analyses over the years assessing the proven high and long-term efficacy and safety of XEOMIN® have shown high levels of patient satisfaction. For example, in a study by Kane and colleagues in 2015, **97.4% of patients were extremely satisfied, satisfied or slightly satisfied** with treatment with XEOMIN® one month after treatment and this figure remained **over 90%** throughout the study.³

**XEOMIN® has been proven to have equivalent efficacy to Botox®** for the treatment of CFL and GFL in randomised controlled trials.³⁻⁵ **XEOMIN® and Botox® displayed comparable spread** at 6 weeks,⁶ and a retrospective analysis of daily practice found that XEOMIN® and Botox® had **similar efficacy and safety profiles** in the upper face.⁷

**XEOMIN® has a faster onset of action than Dysport®.** In a trial comparing XEOMIN® with Botox® and Dysport®, the median onset of action in males and females was assessed by physicians compared with baseline videos and **occurred two days earlier in those treated with XEOMIN® compared with Dysport®.**⁸

Finally, Merz is a global leader in therapeutic innovations with **over 110 years of experience** in dermatology. We are committed to supporting you and your practice with **dedicated marketing and sales support, training and a medical team.** Whether sales, marketing or clinical training, we have you covered.

chapters.heading: 2. I want to try Dysport® as I hear it is the longest-lasting product available

content.text: The duration of effect is an important factor in aesthetic treatments, with an impact on the frequency of repeat treatment and the cost to patients to maintain the treatment effect. An open-label study showed that the **median duration of effect for patients treated with Dysport® was 88 days**, as assessed by investigators.¹

XEOMIN® has been shown to have a **median duration of effect of approximately 6 months**, with a study by Kerscher and colleagues finding a median duration of effect of 177 days.² A study by Prager and colleagues showed that **75% of patients were still responding to treatment at 5 months** (≥1 point improvement compared with baseline).³

Clinical trials and other analyses assessing the proven high and long-term efficacy and safety of XEOMIN® have also shown high levels of patient satisfaction. For example, in a study by Kane and colleagues in 2015, **97.4% of patients were extremely satisfied, satisfied or slightly satisfied** with treatment with XEOMIN® one month after treatment and this figure remained **over 90%** throughout the study.⁴

Using XTRACT™ Technology, we have produced the **first and ONLY toxin free from complexing proteins**.⁵ A formulation purified from complexing proteins like XEOMIN® poses the **lowest risk** of neutralising antibody formation and therefore the lowest risk of **secondary treatment failure**.⁶ This supports the use of XEOMIN® over a lifetime with long-term satisfaction for your patients.

chapters.heading: **3. Dysport® has an impressive onset of action with visible results within 24 hours**

content.text: **A rapid onset of action is an advantage** in an aesthetic procedure contributing to patient satisfaction
In a Phase 3 study of a single treatment of **Dysport®**, the effect of treatment was seen within 24 hours in some cases, with a median time to onset of 3 days¹

However, **a study has also confirmed the rapid onset of XEOMIN®**. In a trial comparing Xeomin® with Botox® and Dysport®, the median onset of action in males and females was assessed by physicians compared with baseline videos and **occurred two days earlier in those treated with XEOMIN® compared with Dysport®**.²

chapters.heading: **4. I like using Dysport® for an effective ‘frozen’ look**

content.text: **It is important to strike a balance between minimising facial lines and maintaining facial dynamics to allow as much facial expression as possible. Injection sites in the face are very close to untargeted muscles, so to minimize unwanted effects it is important to prevent diffusion into nearby muscles.**¹

Kerscher and colleagues showed that **Dysport® had a significantly greater spread than XEOMIN® or Botox®,** meaning that it may be more challenging to get a precise effect when using Azzalure®.¹ The precise localization of XEOMIN® can give you the flexibility to allow for dynamic expression or to target multiple points over a wider area for a greater effect.¹

**Unwanted effects can occur when treatment spreads to untargeted muscles. For example, eyelid ptosis is common in patients treated with Dysport®, seen in 1–10% of patients.**² However, eyelid ptosis is uncommon in patients treated with BOCOUTURE®, seen in only 0.1–1% of patients.³

Using **XTRACT™ Technology**, we have produced the **first and ONLY toxin free from complexing proteins.**⁴ A formulation purified from complexing proteins like XEOMIN® poses the **lowest risk** of neutralising antibody formation and therefore the **lowest risk of secondary treatment failure.**⁵ This supports the use of XEOMIN® over a lifetime with long-term satisfaction for your patients.

content.text: **XEOMIN® has over 15 years of scientific and clinical evidence**,¹ as well as over **200 publications** and over **10 million vials** sold worldwide²

Clinical trials and other analyses over the years assessing the proven high and long-term efficacy and safety of BOCOUTURE® have also explored patient-reported outcomes. A 2015 study by Kane et al. showed that **97.4% of patients were extremely satisfied, satisfied or slightly satisfied with treatment with XEOMIN®** one month after treatment and were over 90% throughout the study.³ A study of patients treated with Dysport® showed similar levels of satisfaction, with patient satisfaction ranging from 96.0–98.9% between treatment cycles.⁴

chapters.heading: **6. Dysport® contains more neurotoxin in the vial**

content.text: The total foreign protein load in Dysport is 0.65ng/100 U, while in XEOMIN there is 0.44ng/100 U¹
However, **most toxins actually contain inactivate neurotoxin** in the vial.
**XEOMIN® has been purified using XTRACT™ Technology**, to produce the first and ONLY toxin free from complexing proteins, including inactive neurotoxin.²
Hence, if you compare the biological activity in both products, **Dysport® has 154 U/ng¹ while Xeomin® has 227 U/ng¹**
